areas.t:
[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
Satellite this morning shows that more cloud cover is in the area, and daily ozone levels will be lower today. There will be less cloud cover over the weekend and into early next week,

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, periods of calm to light south-southeasterly morning winds will inhibit dispersion. However, as a weak cold front traverses the Imperial Valley, light to moderate west-southwesterly winds will develop in the afternoon, dispersing pollutants. Therefore, AQI levels will be high-Good.  Tomorrow,
